_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-opus-5) - Authored per curated-snapshot-format.md §2.1 (task T032). additionalProperties is false everywhere so an unmapped field is a hard failure rather than a silent pass-through. edition_id is NOT carried on child records in the tree: the tree is scoped by its data/<edition-code>/ directory, and the builder re-attaches edition_id from this file when emitting the bundle.

edition_rules.description: Sorted by rule_key. `value` is any JSON value; the builder serialises it into the consumer schema's edition_rule.value_json with the same canonical serialiser used everywhere else, so the emission is byte-stable.
